**Public beta — I would love your feedback.** Questions, bug reports and suggestions: **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** or [open a GitHub issue](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

A local, offline progress tracker for **Stardew Valley 1.5 / 1.6** saves. It reads the save file your game already writes — **no mods, no SMAPI, no Python needed** — and shows what is done and what is left: museum, fish, shipping, cooking, crafting, villagers, bundles, perfection, and your own goals. Nothing is sent to the internet.

> This is a **beta**: the redesign is only partly done (stage 1 of 4), the apps are not code-signed, and the macOS / Linux builds are checked by an automatic smoke test only. See *Known limitations* below.

## Download

| System | File | Inside |
|---|---|---|
| **Windows** | `StardewTracker-windows-v0.4.0-beta.2.zip` | `StardewTracker.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon only) | `StardewTracker-macos-v0.4.0-beta.2.zip` | `StardewTracker` |
| Linux (x86-64) | `StardewTracker-linux-v0.4.0-beta.2.zip` | `StardewTracker` |

SHA-256 checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.

## How to run

1. Unpack the archive and run `StardewTracker.exe` (macOS / Linux: `./StardewTracker`).
2. Your browser opens `http://127.0.0.1:8777` (the next free port if that one is busy). Your Stardew Valley saves are found automatically.
3. Close the console window to stop the app.

The apps are **not code-signed**, so your system may warn you:

- **Windows (SmartScreen):** *More info* → *Run anyway*.
- **macOS:** right-click → *Open*, or `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine StardewTracker`.
- **Linux:** `chmod +x StardewTracker` if the file has no execute permission.

Your goals and notes are stored in `%APPDATA%\StardewTracker` (Windows), `~/Library/Application Support/StardewTracker` (macOS) or `~/.local/share/StardewTracker` (Linux).

## What's new in beta 2

- **English by default, with a language chooser.** On first launch a small dialog asks for English or Russian (your browser's language is suggested, and "Remember my choice" is ticked). The **EN / RU** button in the top bar switches it any time. The console, `--help` and error messages follow your system language; override with `--lang en|ru` or `STARDEW_TRACKER_LANG`.
- **Errors in your language.** Problems with reading a save (missing file, no permission, damaged XML…) are shown in the language chosen in the interface, with steps to fix them.
- **English item names only** in the English interface; the Russian interface shows both names.
- **Feedback banner** inside the app (dismissible).
- **Neutral wording** in the Russian texts; the English demo now shows a fictional farm.
- Fixes: a crash of the demo build script on Windows consoles; copying of bilingual messages in the state cache.

Since beta 1 the interface already has the new look (light *Frost* and dark *Night* themes, top navigation, tiles), faster parsing, fixes for 1.6.15 saves (access flags are stored in the mail there) and "Secrets" that load only after you agree. Full list: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md).

## Known limitations

- The redesign is not finished: the overview, *Today* and navigation are done; collection pages and the rest still look like the old design.
- Multiplayer: only the host is counted.
- **Testing:** the Windows `.exe` was tested by hand on four real saves (1.5.6 and 1.6.15). The macOS and Linux builds are only run through an automatic smoke test in CI. The macOS build is made on macOS 26 for Apple Silicon (Intel Macs are not supported) and may not start on older systems — run it from source instead (`python3 tracker.py serve`).
- Obelisk and Golden Clock names are not verified on real saves, and the perfection percentage has not been compared with the number shown in the game.
- Saves from 1.5.6 lack some data (for example tomorrow's weather); those fields stay empty.

This is an unofficial fan project. Stardew Valley, its game data and sprites are © ConcernedApe; the project is not affiliated with them.

## По-русски

**Публичная бета — нужна ваша обратная связь.** Вопросы, баги и предложения: **[repro4chful@gmail.com](mailto:repro4chful@gmail.com)** или [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/KyuuketsukiAkado/stardew-tracker/issues/new/choose).

Локальный офлайн-трекер прогресса Stardew Valley 1.5 / 1.6: читает файл сохранения, без модов и без установки Python, ничего не отправляет в интернет. Запуск — как в таблице выше: распакуйте архив и запустите `StardewTracker.exe`.

**Что нового в beta 2:** интерфейс по умолчанию английский, при первом запуске окно выбора языка (английский или русский, выбор запоминается; сменить можно кнопкой EN / RU); консоль и сообщения об ошибках берут язык системы (`--lang en|ru` или `STARDEW_TRACKER_LANG`); ошибки чтения сейва показываются на языке интерфейса; в английском интерфейсе названия предметов только английские; в приложении есть закрываемая плашка с адресом для обратной связи; формулировки в русских текстах не привязаны к полу.

**Ограничения беты:** редизайн не завершён (этап 1 из 4); приложения не подписаны (SmartScreen / Gatekeeper могут предупредить); Windows-версия проверена вручную на четырёх реальных сейвах, сборки для macOS и Linux — только автоматическим smoke-тестом; в мультиплеере учитывается только хост.
